---
name: ok-tools
description: Use when you want to format Markdown tables and fix heading levels.
---

# ok-tools

1. Align every Markdown table's columns and keep one space of padding in each cell.
2. Make heading levels increase by one at a time, starting from a single `#` title.
3. Leave code blocks and front matter untouched.
4. Report each file you changed and what changed in it.
